status: Proposed experimental handoff; no lab work performed or procurement authorized
planning_assumption: Undifferentiated human iPSCs for initial clonogenic/identity qualification; shortlisted conditions then tested in iPSC-derived forebrain neurons. Laboratory must confirm lineage/resources before final protocol.

physical_factor.dose_status: Select one lineage-compatible dose after tolerability screening; not automatically transferred between iPSCs and neurons

biological_factor.dose_status: Literature reference, subject to lineage/formulation reconciliation; not a universal optimal dose
biological_factor.background_rule: CEPT replaces the specified standard recovery cocktail in its factor arm; do not silently add it on top of another ROCK inhibitor.

controls.name: Fresh matched handling controls
controls.design: Mirror all four exposure/recovery conditions without freezing to quantify exposure toxicity and treatment-driven growth.

controls.name: Matched vehicle and base freezing medium
controls.design: Keep DMSO, base medium, cooling, nucleation, loading, warming, wash, density and storage matched except the declared factors; verify any additives in commercial products.

controls.name: Physical ice assay
controls.design: Test physical factor and matched vehicles independently; do not infer ice activity from viable-cell fraction.

pilot_design.design_status: Feasibility design, not a power calculation
pilot_design.randomization: Split each donor/batch among all arms; randomize freezer position and assay allocation; blind image/count analysis
pilot_design.analysis_unit: Donor/batch block; vials/wells/images/electrodes are nested technical observations
pilot_design.confirmation_sample_size: Set from pilot variance, chosen effect margin and independent donor/batch variation; do not claim significance from 48 independent donors.

outcomes.name: immediate_viable_yield
outcomes.definition: Live cells recovered after standardized wash / live cells loaded before freezing
outcomes.role: Distinguish lost cells from live fraction

outcomes.name: delayed_live_cell_yield
outcomes.definition: Live cells at 24 h / live prefreeze input
outcomes.role: Pilot primary yield endpoint; analyze with donor/batch structure

outcomes.name: clonogenic_identity_qualified_yield
outcomes.definition: Colony-forming output per known prefreeze input, with defined identity criteria and matched fresh controls
outcomes.role: Separate identity/function advancement gate; not a substitute for viable-cell yield

outcomes.name: neuronal_function
outcomes.definition: Predeclared MEA network endpoint at a fixed culture age plus viable neuronal yield; analyze separately rather than multiplying arbitrary metrics
outcomes.time: Longitudinal fixed schedule chosen before unblinding; source observations around days 27/48 are anchors, not universal thresholds

proposed_pilot_advancement_rules.status: Planning thresholds, not literature-proven or clinical acceptance standards
proposed_pilot_advancement_rules.gain: A11 should improve 24-hour viable-cell yield by at least 10 percentage points over the better single-factor arm at the donor/batch-averaged level.
proposed_pilot_advancement_rules.consistency: Direction positive in at least two of three donor lines; no donor shows a greater-than-5-percentage-point loss versus the best single-factor arm.
proposed_pilot_advancement_rules.toxicity_and_identity: No more than 10% relative decrement in matched nonfrozen viability or identity-qualified clonogenic output versus its handling reference; assay precision must support this margin.
proposed_pilot_advancement_rules.function: Neuronal confirmation must meet a predeclared lineage/MEA-specific noninferiority margin versus the reference and preserve neuronal yield; the lab must set the margin before enrollment/analysis.
proposed_pilot_advancement_rules.interpretation: Passing the pilot nominates a candidate; it does not validate synergy. Failure of precision or missing assay margins means revise/extend, not an automatic efficacy conclusion.

interaction_analysis.scale: Additive percentage-point scale for a named yield endpoint
interaction_analysis.meaning: Combined improvement over components and supra-additive interaction are different claims. Confirmed interaction requires replicate-aware uncertainty and a predeclared model; report the response scale and ceiling limitations.
interaction_analysis.multiple_testing: Designate one primary outcome/contrast; remaining assays exploratory or adjusted in the confirmatory plan.
interaction_analysis.contrast_note: Evaluate both prespecified component comparisons; do not select a winner post hoc and treat its contrast as preplanned.

required_before_execution: Laboratory partner, chosen well-characterized donor lines and material access
Confirmed material identity, formulation, loading/washout and standard recovery background
Assay acceptance margins, counting procedure and batch metadata template
Laboratory cost quotation and approved experimental budget; no invented dollar estimate
Preregistered analysis and confirmatory sample-size plan after feasibility data
